This suggests the model is confused by the metallic beads mimicking links. This is a semantic alignment weakness, not a visual artifact, but supports the idea that the generation is not perfectly class-conformant.

Most checkpoints are passed or appropriately N/A. The score is penalized slightly because the specific 'link pattern' checkpoint failed (due to being beaded) and the classifier confidence was split.
